snippet.title: MakeMyTrip’s Myra goes end-to-end: search to payment in one conversation.
snippet.description:
The hardest part of conversational AI booking isn't the conversation. It's closing the loop, taking a traveler all the way to a confirmed, paid booking, all inside the same conversation.

The upgraded Myra closes that loop. Across 7 Indian languages and English. By voice, if you prefer. For domestic and international trips, including the layered, real-world constraints that don't fit into filters.
A few numbers from Myra:
Myra has crossed 3 million conversations a quarter, with over 45% of usage now coming from Tier-2 and smaller cities. Travellers who engage Myra convert at 10% higher rates than those on traditional, filter-led journeys. Voice prompts run around 40% longer than text, signalling deeper, more layered intent.

"The next shift in travel search will be shaped in large part by voice. Myra is how we are getting ready for that shift, while continuing to serve the traveller of today." Rajesh Magow, Co-Founder and Group CEO, MakeMyTrip
Rolling out now on MakeMyTrip

snippet.title: Would you believe us if we told you this is in Meghalaya?
snippet.description:
Yes, it’s true. This is the Umngot River in Meghalaya.
This river is renowned for its exceptionally clear waters, often described as transparent or crystal clear. This clarity allows visitors to see straight to the riverbed, creating stunning visual effects and making it a popular destination for photography and sightseeing.
One of the most popular activities on the Umngot River is boating. You can take a traditional wooden boat ride or rent a paddle boat and explore the river at your own pace.
🗓️The best time to visit is during the dry season, from November to April.

snippet.title: Rediscover Leh-Ladakh with Kritika Khurana
snippet.description:
Thanks to my job, I’ve had the opportunity to visit so many places around the country💛. But even after travelling to multiple places, I still can’t get enough of #MyIndia🇮🇳✨. The love and warmth you get here can’t be compared to any other place in the world💌🌎. Here, every city here has its essence, but one of my personal favourites is Leh-Ladakh❄️⛩️. 

The culture, calmness, and delicious authentic cuisines, make this place SO special✨. From the classic food Thumpka🍲and Momos🥟 to the Zanskar Valley and Pangong Tso Lake🙌🏼, this majestic place is nothing less than a dream for travel enthusiasts🧳☁️. Apart from these already famous places and cuisines, there’s still a lot to explore. So, here’s what I explored📍! 

✨Stok Palace: Built in 1820 by the Ladakhi men⛏️, the Stok Palace is home to the Namgyal Dynasty. The doors of this palace were opened to the common public after receiving the blessings of His Holiness Dalai Lama in 1980🏮.
✨Sangam Valley: It’s a 48 km drive from Leh, and acts as a confluence for the rivers Indus and Zanskar. 
✨Magnetic Hill: Known as the ‘Cyclops Hill’, the Magnetic Hill is located in Leh-Ladakh. The most amazing part? On these hills, things don’t seem to obey the laws of gravity, and instead of rolling downhill, they go uphill😲
✨Likir Monastery: Also known as Likir Gompa, it’s a Buddhist monastery located in Ladakh, some 52 km from Leh. Buddhists believe that the Snake King, Joker slept here at this monastery once and that the monastery is guarded by the spirits of two great snakes, namely Nanda and Taksako 👑🐍. 

If you also want to explore #MyIndia with a new perspective, Leh-Ladakh is the best place to start your ‘exploring the hidden gems’ journey 🛄💎. Just book your flights, hotels, and cabs on the @makemytrip app and get started with it! 𝐀𝐥𝐬𝐨, 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐜𝐚𝐧 𝐠𝐞𝐭 𝟏𝟎% 𝐨𝐟𝐟 𝐨𝐧 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐛𝐨𝐨𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐬 𝐢𝐟 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐮𝐬𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐨𝐝𝐞 - 𝐌𝐘𝐈𝐍𝐃𝐈𝐀 📲! 

- Kritika Khurana

snippet.title: Rediscover Andaman with Shenaz Treasury
snippet.description:
I believe that even if I manage to travel the entire world someday, my heart will forever stay biased towards #MyIndia🇮🇳 ❤️. India is a complete package of beauty, culture, heritage, and the new-age world. How can one not fall in love, tell me?
One of my most favourite places in India is Andaman Island. Surrounded by surreal beaches, sand, and crystal clear water, this place is no less than a paradise🌊 🏖️ 🐚. Apart from the famous Ross Islands and Cellular Jail, there’s so much more to explore here. These are the hidden gems I found during my trip💎 📍: 
 
✨ Natural Bridges, Neil Island: A masterpiece of nature, I must say. This place has a naturally shaped bridge-like rock, which is also known as the Howrah Bridge. 🗿 🌉
 
✨ Radhanagar beach: This is one of the most beautiful beaches in Asia. Its perfectly turquoise coloured water, white sand, serenity, and peaceful ambiance will instantly make you fall in love with the place. 🏖️
 
✨ Neil’s Cove: If you’re a fan of swimming and snorkeling, Neil’s Cove is THE place for you. Clear blue water and calm sea, a dream for all! 🏊‍♀️
 
✨ Mangroves-Havelock Island: Want to take the incredible experience of Kayaking? Make sure you visit this beautiful place! 🚣‍♀️
 
✨ Sitapur beach, Neil Island: Situated at the tip of the island, this is called the ‘sunrise beach.’ If you want to experience the most magical sunrise, then don’t forget to check this beach out. 🏖️ 🌅
 
✨ Turtle beach, Havelock Island: This is a hub for all scuba diving and snorkeling enthusiasts. Visit this place and experience the surreal underwater world. 🐢

Dear Women,

Would you rather be applauded for your selflessness or gift yourself a much needed break that would truly make you happy? snippet.title: Rediscover Puducherry with Shivesh Bhatia
snippet.description:
Where are you heading this summer☀️? ‘Cause the land of Puducherry awaits you. My quest for new experiences and adventures has always helped me find some of the greatest gems of my life💎. Be it new cuisines, cultures, or places - I plan to keep adding more & more to my Life Book as I grow older 📖🎒
And I wish the same for you guys as well! There is a thrill in exploring different cultures, cuisines, landscapes - one you can only experience once you take the plunge! 

Here are a few gems I explored, that filled me with pride for #MyIndia 🇮🇳 🙌-

✨Immaculate Conception Cathedral - This is the Cathedral Mother Church for the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Pondicherry and Cuddalore. A pristine, beautiful piece of architecture that this cathedral is, it can mesmerise everyone ! ⛪

✨Auroville - A melting pot of different cultures and customs- people from all over the world come together to live here in perfect harmony☮️

✨Mason & Co. Chocolate Factory: Known as one of India’s finest chocolate brands, it’s also popular for its organic chocolates and pretty interesting flavours. Plus, getting to see how chocolate is made is a one-in-a-million experience!🍫

✨Chunnambar Boat House - It’s popular as a tropical paradise amongst many, offering a brilliant boathouse experience. You can sail downstream here and set up a camp by the seashore for yourself 🛶🌴

✨Paradise Beach - How can a visit to the beautiful Puducherry be complete if one of its gorgeous beaches aren’t included? This beach is a serene one, famous for its tranquil coastline and soft sands, and is actually nothing less than a paradise 🏖️

snippet.title: Rediscover Sikkim with Aakriti Rana
snippet.description:
With fresh air, blue skies, snow-capped mountains, and lush green valleys, Sikkim has it all in abundance⭐. I’m amazed to see that each lane and corner of this place has something unique to offer. Here are some of the hidden gems I visited📍: 

✨Snow-tsongmo lake: Covered in snow, this famous glacial lake changes colors. Truly magical, I must say. 🗻

✨Temi Tea estate: This place is a heaven for tea and nature lovers! From clear blue skies to high-quality tea production, you can find it all here. 🌱

✨Tathagata Tsal (Buddha Park): Rich in culture and history, Tathagata Tsal (Buddha Park) has a  130-foot (40 m) high statue of the Buddha as its centrepiece and is one of the most famous tourist attractions in Sikkim. 🧘🏼‍♂️

✨Ban Jhakri Falls: Majestic waterfalls and the greenery that surrounds it definitely is a treat to the eyes. One of the most beautiful getaways in Sikkim. 

✨Do Drul Chorten Monastery: Visit this Buddhist stupa in Gangtok and get a glimpse of the Buddhist culture and architecture. ⛩️

snippet.title: Rediscover Andhra Pradesh with Nishchay Jain
snippet.description:
I really wish my eyes could capture pictures because Andhra’s beauty is too gorgeous to fit in any camera lens. ✨

Be it the aesthetic caves, magical waterfalls or just the beauty of nature🌅🌏, exploring and capturing the essence of these places is a dream come true.🙌🏼 I just hope that my photography is doing justice to these majestic locations. Some of the hidden gems I saw during this trip are: 

✨ Borra Caves: These marvellous creations of nature are the largest and the deepest caves in India. Situated in Visakhapatnam, these caves are surrounded by beautiful landscapes, lush-green valleys and wild fauna. 🌳

✨ Araku Valley: Filled with greenery and fresh air, this place gives a refreshing break from the hectic city life. With its exquisite biodiversity and a wide variety of coffee plantations, Araku Valley is on its way to becoming a famous tourist destination. 🤩

✨ Bojjannakonda: Rich in culture and history, Bojjannakonda is a significant tourist site in Andhra. These caves are a notable establishment of Buddhism and feature its three phases - Mahayana, Hinayana and Vajrayana.🧘🏼‍♂️

✨Mangamaripeta Beach: It is believed that this region was under the kingdom of Kalinga and later served as a promotional center for Buddhism. It also offers a wide variety of adventure sports like snorkelling, jet-skiing and scuba diving. 🤿

You can pick tents if you want camping feels - they are spacious and comfortable with running water and power supply. If you want something more traditional, pick a traditional Gujarati bhunga. But the best part is the hotel’s proximity to the salt desert - The White Rann of Kutch is a stone's throw away and we highly recommend visiting it at both sunrise and sunset.
